methods.name: GetCruiseSpeed
methods.summary: Returns the cruising speed of the grid.

methods.name: GetMaxSpeed
methods.summary: Returns the maximum speed, including boost and configured caps.

methods.name: GetBoost
methods.summary: Returns forward boost, minimum, average, and maximum.

methods.name: GetAcceleration
methods.summary: Returns forward acceleration, minimum, average, and maximum.

methods.name: GetAccelerationByDirection
methods.summary: Returns acceleration indexed by Base6Directions.Direction (Forward, Backward, Left, Right, Up, Down). Each entry describes thrust in that grid direction; movement acceleration is in the opposite direction.
